name: My Platform
plannerHints: Search first, then open a semantically relevant result.
Prefer stable IDs and aria-label selectors over brittle class chains.
recoveryHints: If target content is missing, run a fresh on-site search.
Avoid reusing stale selectors from a different page mode.
verificationHints: Task succeeds only when the target detail page is visible.
A generic click is not enough if URL/state did not transition.
